gloss: to pay attention; to be attentive; to be considerate

definitions.gloss: to pay attention to; to be attentive to; to take care of
definitions.explanation: To direct one's awareness and consideration toward something or someone. Implies thoughtful, ongoing attention rather than a momentary glance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{配|くば}る。

examples.english: She is someone who is considerate of those around her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{配|くば}って、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm mindful of my health, so I try to eat vegetables every day.

notes:
A common expression meaning to direct one's attention and care toward something. Composed of ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit, attention) and ⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ (to distribute), so the literal sense is "to distribute one's attention." Implies a sustained, proactive awareness rather than a momentary focus.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to pay attention to [noun]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to pay attention to safety
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to be mindful of one's health
- ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to be attentive to one's surroundings
- ⟦{細部|さいぶ}→細部：20562_saibu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{配|くば}る: to pay attention to detail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧: to be careful — focuses on avoiding danger or mistakes, more about caution
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う→注意を払う：18393_chuuiwoharau⟧: to pay attention — more formal, similar meaning
- ⟦{目|め}を{配|くば}る→目を配る：30621_mewokubaru⟧: to keep an eye on — emphasizes visual monitoring
- ⟦{心遣|こころづか}い→心遣い：07296_kokorozukai⟧: consideration, thoughtfulness — noun form of a similar concept
